context_files.purpose: Visibility, taint, reset, and sterility contract.

system_thesis_interpretation: The benchmark asks whether a pinned, frozen agent can convert its own growing public action--outcome history into target-blind per-life text memory that improves later, unseen finite causal-map actions after native raw context is exceeded. The relevant organism is action -> public evidence -> prospective/revision compilation -> immutable snapshot/read -> later action, not merely a memory-format comparison. The proposal appropriately confines a positive result to a finite synthetic range and a frozen controller; it cannot support generic SOTA, unbounded learning, a learned controller/compiler, naturalistic development, or formal mediation.
graph_delta_interpretation: The decisive change is from a fixed source trajectory to a common opportunity deck with arm-owned legal actions and outcomes. The benchmark makes the proposed path testable through AUTH/TWIN/NULL diagnostic forks: assigned checkpoint memory changes one probe, is unmounted and reset, its ordinary public outcome is compiled from a common authentic prior, and only the resulting branch delta may reach sterile later action. D4 and A4 correctness are representation-neutral world/action/terminal-return values, so a SELF record, status, reader receipt, or backend cannot itself earn success. Common-history and same-event lanes separately ask whether generic SELF beats raw RAG, mechanical/witness, linked/rolling, and recurrent KV under the same online envelope; the exact program is a construct ceiling, not a learned baseline.
loop_delta_interpretation: Ordinary lives have presealed opportunities but on-policy evidence. Before any scientific call, A2 must bind the model/DSL/reader/caps and three treatment-defining policies: multi-sample SELF reducer/admission with disagreement and malformed/abstained/failed slots; Dream-1/Dream-2/block/snapshot cadence; and checkpoint lifecycle/readability with constant-shape unavailable slots. A later fork is not allowed to bypass this cognition: it uses common pre-fork P1 compiler draws, bounded Dream-2 from raw branch outcome, then a sterile evaluator with common prior plus delta. The benchmark distinguishes transport, composition, action improvement, acquisition, and retention: P1 contains every cascade/compiler/binding requirement; P2 tests new acquisition at every post-native checkpoint; P3 requires both first acquisition and 6L endpoint above a root-specific floor plus retention noninferiority; P4 beats the root-wise strongest full-surface baseline on cross-era AUC.
claim_delta_interpretation: C1 requires generic model-owned text to exceed the strongest same-history non-SELF condition and lose value under outcome/semantic interventions; C2 requires the randomized, unmounted, failure-inclusive chain-complete P1 contrast, explicitly not a natural indirect effect; C3 additionally requires P2--P4 in the frozen 26-root IUT. A4 is integrity-only for current text claims: all assigned rows, world/action V, sterility, leakage closure, and failures count, but revision/recovery/retention efficacy is descriptive. LoRA is not applicable to C1--C3: NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D is the correct passing disposition, and any LoRA assertion needs separately ratified powered work. September evidence is construct plus labeled eight-root DEV/falsification only, never confirmation, superiority, plateau, or a continual-learning claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The benchmark is only interpretable if treatment descendants are closed: post-probe RESET destroys exploration memory, actor conversation/workspace/reader state/caches/candidate order and error/timing state; the delta compiler sees common authentic prior, common Dream-1 bytes, and only the public branch event; evaluation sees immutable common prior plus branch delta in a fresh sterile process. Hidden truth, target allocation, scorer/comparator/downstream result, DEV result, assignment metadata, labels, order, and capability handles must not influence generic compiler/reducer/cadence/reader bytes, seeds, or later action. A2 mutation/golden suites and A1 taint/reset mutants are therefore benchmark validity requirements, not implementation niceties.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 requires total presealed opportunities/targets, valid pre-native reference and strict post-native old-age/growth context. T02 is the paper-killer construct check: target-only/twin shortcuts and low-depth routes must fail, exact program must have itemwise value one, and nonadaptive equal-atom KV must fail while recurrent KV is allowed. T03 requires all three clones on both sides/checkpoints, unmount/reset, assignment-independent paired compiler RNG, binding/outcome/cut controls, cumulative links, and P1 without claiming formal mediation. T04 requires model-owned prospective/revision bytes and mechanical extraction as supplied preprocessing/control, with representation-neutral action scoring and all resources charged. T05 requires raw RAG, nonadaptive/recurrent KV, both frozen external candidates, MECH/program, generic and class-informed SELF; DEV may select only frozen AS-EXT, while the primary comparisons use strongest eligible baselines. T06 requires 26 independent roots, 908 assigned rows/root with failures, P1--P4 root composites, four alpha-.05 IUT tests, simultaneous SD-UCB <=.30, diagnostics, and the sole all-four simulation gate: every admissible scenario has 99% joint-power lower bound >.80 and global-null-size upper bound <=.0525; .951579 marginal and .806317 dependence-free joint values are planning arithmetic only. T07 requires component and metadata taint closure, seed-independence/equality mutants, sterility and reset. T08 forbids Cartesian pruning and locks A0--A2/B0--B3 ordering, caps/calendar, complete resource projection, and post-Sep-25 confirmation. T09 is current-text integrity-only, never A4 efficacy. T10 is NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D for C1--C3. T11 requires independent reproduction and a non-authorizing approve-narrow/null/not-run/reject disposition. T12 requires the pre-B0 byte freeze, including reducer, cadence, status reader, blindness goldens, compiler CRN, fresh review, and exact later human model-call authorization; any cognition change restarts DEV.
assumptions: The future implementation can certify that semantic descriptors, target bytes, current state, identifiers, and passive source strings do not reveal decisive mappings or a target-complete route.

A2 can express and independently test the full reducer, ordinary cadence, lifecycle reader, seed encoding, and target/truth/result-blind mutation suite as executable bytes before any B-stage model call.
The presealed worlds can supply all assigned strict-age OLD/CROSS rows, unique mappings, and four-event integrative targets within the pinned tokenizer and resource tolerances.
Every valid baseline is given its legitimate native write/read policy and its actual offline plus online resource vector is recorded rather than equal compute being inferred from equal visible bytes.
The frozen simulator can enumerate all stated admissible dependence, tail, and failure scenarios without silently declaring adverse scenarios infeasible.

ambiguities.question: Whether the planned 908-row/root and 520-H100-equivalent/6.5-TB caps remain feasible after real B0--B3 rates are measured is unknown.
ambiguities.impact: Stage C must be calibration-only or stop if the complete roster and review/calendar slack do not fit; cells, roots, or failure denominators cannot be pruned.

ambiguities.question: Whether generic SELF can exceed the strongest recurrent KV, raw, MECH, linked, or rolling same-history condition under the common six-read envelope is empirical and may be false.
ambiguities.impact: A match or loss leaves finite causal-memory performance reportable but withholds C1 model-owned offline-compilation/reconsolidation advantage and makes P1 nonpositive.

ambiguities.question: Whether the minimum-based P1--P3 composites will meet the simultaneous SD and distribution conditions at only eight DEV roots is unknown.
ambiguities.impact: The design correctly treats diagnostic, SD-UCB, or every-scenario joint simulation failure as a calibration stop rather than repaired confirmation power.

ambiguities.question: The proposal specifies the required A2 artifacts but not their final executable bytes or a completed independent review receipt.
ambiguities.impact: No scientific model call, DEV inference, or claim is authorized; missing A2/review/human scope is NOT_RUN rather than an inferred approval.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal's organism-level motivation is broader than what this benchmark can establish.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The fixed controller, finite PCFL causal maps, and bounded context/read/action envelope can demonstrate only a controlled finite-range action-conditioned memory result, even if all four composites pass.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the C1--C3 claim ceiling verbatim-narrow; do not route any positive result into generic self-learning-agent, SOTA, compression, or autonomous-discovery language.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A4 should not be interpreted as a revision-efficacy test for the current text paper decision.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Its V score is representation-neutral and the applicability map intentionally makes only roster integrity, sterility, leakage closure, and failure inclusion required; it does not enter P1--P4.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Report A4 mechanism fields descriptively and require a separately powered, authorized A4 proposal before efficacy language.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: LoRA cannot be used to rescue an inconclusive text benchmark or to represent the present organism claim.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Stage D is not applicable to C1--C3 and the design's causal/compiler attribution depends first on text-only common-history and randomized cascade controls.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Preserve NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D for current text claims; consider LoRA only after passed text confirmation and a fresh ratified proposal.

open_questions: Whether to ratify any proposal bytes after the independent interpretations, critique, and consensus—not this interpretation—are complete.
If later ratified, whether the independently reviewed A2 hashes and exact model/provider, token, cost, root, and stage scope receive separate explicit human authorization before B0.
Whether measured DEV feasibility justifies a separately authorized Stage C; this interpretation grants neither execution nor scientific-claim authority.
